# How to Use Solo Shop Builder

Solo Shop Builder is a private storefront platform designed for independent sellers — crafters, resellers, and side-hustle makers — who want a branded shop URL and simple order management without paying marketplace fees. As a seller, you get one shop with its own web address, a product catalog, and a dashboard to track and manage every order. Customers visit your shop URL directly, browse your products, add items to a cart, and pay securely. No marketplace middleman, no shared storefront.

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Create Your Account

1. Go to the Solo Shop Builder sign-in page (`/auth/login`).
2. Enter your email address and a password, then click **Sign In**. If you don't have an account yet, the same form creates one.
3. Prefer not to use a password? Click **Use magic link instead**, enter your email, and click **Send Login Link**. Check your inbox and click the link — you'll be taken straight into the app.
4. If you ever forget your password, click **Forgot your password?** on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox. When setting a new password, the form shows a live strength indicator — your password needs at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

### 2. Create Your Shop

After signing in for the first time, you'll land on the **Create Your Shop** page (`/dashboard/create-shop`).

1. **Shop Name** — Enter the name customers will see (e.g., *Sarah's Jewelry*). Up to 50 characters.
2. **Web Address (slug)** — A URL-safe version is generated automatically from your shop name (e.g., `sarahs-jewelry`). You can edit it manually. It must be 3–30 characters using only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. A live preview shows your full shop URL as you type.
3. **Currency** — Choose **USD** (payments via Stripe) or **KWD** (payments via MyFatoorah). This cannot be changed easily later, so choose carefully.
4. Click **Create Shop**. Your shop is immediately live at its unique URL (e.g., `soloshop.com/shop/sarahs-jewelry`).

You'll be redirected to your dashboard automatically.

---

## Core Tasks

### Task 1 — Add and Manage Products

**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Products** (📦) → **+ Add Product**

1. Fill in the **Product Title** (required, up to 100 characters).
2. Write a **Description** — materials, dimensions, care instructions, etc. (up to 5,000 characters).
3. Enter a **Price** in your shop's currency (e.g., `45.00` for USD or `45.000` for KWD).
4. Choose a **Category** from the dropdown (Handmade, Vintage, Supplies, Other).
5. Set a **Stock** quantity.
6. Upload a **Product Image** — click the upload area and select a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF file. A preview appears immediately. You can also paste an external image URL.
7. Click **Add Product**. The product appears in your product list.

**On the Products page** you can:
- **Edit** any product by clicking its edit action — all fields are editable.
- **Toggle status** between Published (visible to customers) and Draft (hidden).
- **Delete** a product (you'll be asked to confirm).
- **Export** your entire product list as a CSV file.

**Bulk import:** Go to Dashboard → **CSV Import** (📥). Drag and drop or select a CSV file (max 10 MB). After upload, you'll see how many products were imported and a row-by-row error report for any that failed. You can download the error report as its own CSV to fix and re-upload.

---

### Task 2 — Manage Orders

**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Orders** (📋)

The Orders page shows every order placed in your shop, with summary counts for each status (Paid, In Progress, Shipped, Delivered).

**Filter orders:**
- Use the **status buttons** (All / Paid / In Progress / Shipped / Delivered) to narrow the list.
- Use the **date range pickers** (From / To) to filter by order date.
- Click **Clear Filters** to reset.

**View an individual order:**
Click any order row to open the **Order Detail** page. From here you can:
- See all items, quantities, customer email, and the total paid.
- Update the order status (e.g., mark as In Progress, then Shipped).
- Enter a tracking ID when you ship.
- Issue a refund if needed.

**Export all orders:** On the Orders page, click **📥 Export as CSV** to download the full order list.

---

### Task 3 — Customize Your Shop's Appearance

#### Branding (colors and logo)
**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Branding** (🎨)

1. Use the color pickers or type hex codes to set your **Primary Color** (used for headers and navigation) and **Accent Color** (used for buttons and highlights).
2. Upload a logo image (PNG or JPEG, max 2 MB, square recommended). A preview displays at the size customers will see it. You can also provide an external HTTPS logo URL instead.
3. A live color swatch preview lets you check your choices before saving.
4. Click **Save Branding** to apply.

#### Seller Profile
**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Profile** (👤)

1. Set your public **Shop Name** (up to 100 characters) and a **Shop Description** (up to 500 characters) — both appear on your storefront.
2. Add optional **Social Links** for Twitter/X, Instagram, and Facebook.
3. Click **Save Profile** — changes appear on your shop page immediately.

---

### Task 4 — Customize Order Confirmation Emails

**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Email Templates** (✉️)

1. Edit the **Subject Line** (up to 100 characters). Use merge tags like `{{shopName}}` to personalize it.
2. Edit the **Email Body** (up to 5,000 characters, plain text). A reference panel shows all available merge tags: `{{customerName}}`, `{{orderNumber}}`, `{{orderDate}}`, `{{orderTotal}}`, `{{items}}`, `{{trackingLink}}`, and `{{shopName}}`.
3. A live **Preview** panel shows how the email looks with sample data substituted in.
4. Click **Save Template**. Click **Reset** to restore the default template at any time.

---

### Task 5 — View Analytics and Billing

#### Analytics
**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Analytics** (📊)

- See **Total Revenue**, **Total Orders**, and **Average Order Value** for the last 30 days.
- A **Daily Revenue bar chart** shows revenue trends day by day; hover a bar to see the exact figure.
- A **Top Selling Products** table ranks your products by quantity sold, with the best seller highlighted.

#### Billing
**Navigate:** Dashboard → **Billing** (💳)

- View summary cards: Total Revenue, Total Orders, Average Order, Stripe Fees, and **Net Revenue** (after payment processing fees).
- A full **Transaction History** table lists every order with date, order ID, customer email, gross amount, payment processing fee, net amount, and status.
- A note at the bottom explains that Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, automatically deducted and shown in the Net column.

---

### How Customers Shop at Your Store

Your customers don't need an account. They simply:

1. Visit your shop URL (e.g., `soloshop.com/shop/your-shop`).
2. Browse products and add items to their cart.
3. Go to **Checkout** (`/checkout`), review their order summary, and enter their email address (required for confirmation and tracking).
4. Pay via Stripe (USD shops) or MyFatoorah — with options for card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or KNET (KWD shops).
5. After payment, they land on a **Order Confirmed** page showing a full receipt with order ID, items, and total paid. They can download the receipt as a plain-text file.

---

## Tips & Limits

**Tips:**
- Share your shop URL everywhere — it's the only place customers can buy from you.
- Set products to **Draft** status when they're out of stock so customers can't order items you can't fulfill.
- Use the CSV Import feature to add many products at once if you're migrating from a spreadsheet or another platform.
- The order confirmation email template supports merge tags — always keep `{{orderNumber}}` and `{{orderTotal}}` in the body so customers have the key details.
- Bookmark `/dashboard/analytics` at the end of each week to track which products sell best.

**Honest limits:**
- **One shop per account.** The platform is single-tenant by design — you cannot manage multiple shops under one login.
- **Two currencies supported:** USD (Stripe) and KWD (MyFatoorah). Other currencies are not available, and currency is set at shop creation.
- **No built-in direct messaging.** The spec describes seller-to-customer messaging, but no messaging screen appears in the current pages. Communication happens via the order confirmation email.
- **No shipping address collection at checkout.** The checkout page only asks for a customer email address — no physical address field exists in the current checkout flow.
- **No customer accounts.** Customers check out as guests; there is no order-tracking portal for customers to log into.
- **Categories are fixed.** The product category list (Handmade, Vintage, Supplies, Other) cannot be customized.
- **Logo size constraint.** Uploaded logos are displayed at 40×40 px in the storefront header; keep your logo simple and square for best results.
